purpose: Independent literal product-requirement oracle for R10, authored from accepted prose and recovery contracts before inspecting generated R10 plans. No generator policy imports or output snapshots define expected requirements.
scope: Source acceptance of existing rules, not scientific or clinical validation
precedence: Balanced week 2026-10-09 supersedes older 16-set universal trained-target and multi-primary accounting prose for this balanced strategy. These are retained product rules, not proof that the associated scientific-policy decisions are approved.

balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength.doseProvenance: Balanced week explicitly states heavy 4 and follow 2 at 50/50, support 3. Reps/rest are the pre-existing 50/50 goal blends independently stated in the R05 literal two-day reviewed fixture; they are implementation-contract values, not new science constants.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength.regionAliasProvenance: Balanced week specifies regional chest/back/quads/hamstrings totals. Upper/lower pectorals are chest aliases, not independent quotas. This is exclusive scheduling accounting; do not sum all primary catalogue tags or infer fractional stimulus.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength.supportRule: Three sets per delivered support exposure, at most two exposures. Prose says twice when the week has room and once when it does not; exact support omission/placement at each frequency is not independently specified here. Do not invent per-frequency exact support quotas from generated output.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength.overheadPressRule: One heavy exposure owns front delts; real hard constraints can reject it explicitly.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength.shrugRule: One three-set exposure when the week has room; do not manufacture an exact low-frequency placement.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength.fiveDayPlacementNote: Upper press/row, squat, push-with-no-pull, pull-with-no-press, deadlift order is prescribed literally in Small-muscle volume. Secondary slot placement is not exhaustively specified here; weekly owner totals remain independently mandatory.

balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV4.appliesTo: New builds under weekly policy weekly-20261104-v4. Saved v3 programmes keep balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength above.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV4.roleRule: Both goals at least 0.3 of the 0.05-rounded mix. A heavy own-load lift's first exposure in the week is strength; its repeat exposure and every heavy no-own-load variant are hypertrophy. Follow-up sets, reps and rest use the slot's own priority (accessory or isolation); support stays three sets.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV4.doseProvenance: Hand-computed from rules/rules.v1.json single-goal rows at 50/50: heavy 0.5x3+0.5x4=3.5->4; accessory 0.5x2+0.5x3=2.5->3, range [6.5,11.5]->[7,12], target 9, rest 90; isolation 1.5->2, [9,16], target 12, rest 52.5->55. Strength/hypertrophy targets 5 and 8 are the operator-approved exposure targets.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV4.weeklySetsProvenance: Sum of the balanced-week placements at the v4 doses above; e.g. five days lats = row 4 + pulldown 3 + pull-up 4 + row follow-up 3 = 14, chest = bench 4+4 + fly 2+2 = 12.

balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV5.appliesTo: New builds under weekly policy weekly-20261105-v5. Saved v4 programmes keep balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV4 above; saved v3 programmes keep balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrength.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV5.roleRule: As v4, plus: an own-load lift whose lead exercise is bodyweight takes the strength role only with an entered, eligible added-load variant; otherwise it is a hypertrophy exposure. A hypertrophy exposure of a compound slot rests 120 s.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV5.doseProvenance: v4 doses unchanged except hypertrophy rest 120 s (brief item 3, Schoenfeld et al. 2016). Core is a support requirement: 3 sets, isolation reps and rest.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV5.sessionCaps: No session time cap and no session total-set cap; per exercise <= 5 sets and per owner muscle per session <= 10 sets (D-P2-01 amendment, Warren-approved 2026-11-05).
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV5.weeklySetsProvenance: Brief item 6, two days genuine full body: chest bench 4+4 + fly 2 = 10; lats row 4 + pull-up 4 = 8; quads squat 4 + quad heavy 4 = 8; hamstrings RDL 4 + deadlift 4 = 8. Three to six days keep the v4 placements and doses. Core: two days one slot per day, three days two, four to six days three, 3 sets each.
balancedHalfMuscleHalfStrengthV5.firstOwnersProvenance: Brief item 3 order: Wednesday's first strength exposure is the overhead press; the bench repeat is a hypertrophy exposure and follows it.

invariants.sameInputsAbsentNewQualifiedHistory: Same strength days, sets and loads across weeks; calendar passage alone cannot increase load.
invariants.ownership: Exclusive scheduling ownership is not anatomical involvement or physiological stimulus. Bench does not count as direct arm/shoulder dose.
invariants.baseline: Own-exercise ceiling; uncalibrated variation must not inherit baseline kg or per-dumbbell semantics.
invariants.eligibility: Actual final catalogue IDs satisfy explicit ALL/ANY equipment, exact contraindications, forbidden movements, dislikes and slot-context skill opt-in. A missing candidate is explicit infeasibility, never successful empty work.
invariants.frozen: Started/guided prescriptions and canonical performed work remain unchanged when future history or policy changes.
invariants.recovery: No new rest-gap, fatigue, deload, RIR or progression constant is authorized. Check accepted caps, preserved explicit holds and mixed frozen/future behavior; do not claim measured recovery adequacy.
invariants.repetition: Repeated exercises across days/weeks are not inherently defects. Five-day push cannot contain back pulling; each chest exposure keeps heavy plus follow dose without multiplying the weekly dose. Within-session duplicate exercise IDs or inappropriate duplicate compounds must be rejected according to accepted slot policy.

requiredAdversarialVerdicts.fiveDayFloorOnly: Explicit infeasibility with missing capability; never five successful empty sessions
requiredAdversarialVerdicts.dumbbellPullWithoutBack: Explicit missing back requirement or eligible back work; curls/rear-delts/shrugs alone cannot pass
requiredAdversarialVerdicts.hybridTwoOrThreeDays: Explicit infeasibility pending D-P2-03; strength-only output cannot pass as delivered hybrid
requiredAdversarialVerdicts.labelRename: No change in prescribed work for stable strategy and identical normalized input

rpeNineFrom100.status: Existing R07 rule behavior only; not science approval

requiredAdversarialVerdicts.equipmentOrRestrictionChange: Final selected and substituted exercises must satisfy current saved hard constraints or be refused explicitly
requiredAdversarialVerdicts.unavailableHistory: Unavailable evidence cannot masquerade as known absence or qualified progression
requiredAdversarialVerdicts.partiallyCompletedWork: Partial evidence cannot become full successful-session progression; replacement cannot relabel partial/completed work

pendingScientificPolicy.D-P2-02: RD-001 evidence-gated progression conflicts with RD-006 calendar 20/20/30/30 schedule; numeric compatibility can pass, scientific progression remains unresolved
pendingScientificPolicy.D-P2-04: Muscle stimulus, dose/population applicability and clinical boundaries
pendingScientificPolicy.D-P2-05: Automatic skip/fatigue capability; no silent skip or invented fatigue formula
pendingScientificPolicy.D-P2-06: Entered lift missing-rack exception remains diagnostic policy waiver, not proof of equipment
